objective: Port mutable Array2 prefix views and a borrowed Array2::Init reference path while retaining honest limits for read-only views and source aliasing.

native_behavior.buffer_constructor: NCollection_Array2(pointer, rows, cols) stores a non-owning row-major pointer view of exactly rows*cols elements; pointer constructor has no backing-buffer length and therefore ignores later storage.
native_behavior.init: NCollection_Array2::Init(const_reference) delegates to Array1::Init and assigns from the same borrowed source to each flat slot in order; the custom native probe observes four assignments and zero copy constructions.
native_behavior.limits: Rust requires a real mutable slice and returns DimensionMismatch when shorter than rows*cols; native invalid/null/undersized pointers are not modeled. Surplus capacity is valid and untouched. Rust shared read-only views detach on mutation; native pointer alias/self-source edge cases are not claimed.

compiler_bindings.test: tools/tests/test_ncollection_array2_prefix_binding.py resolves both exact constructor/Init selectors against the pinned C++ inventory and parity targets.

rust_probe.assertions: Array2::init_ref borrows the source; the caller changes that still-live source after assignment. Four clone_from assignments update only the 2x2 prefix, zero Clone::clone constructions occur, and the two spare values remain 104,105. Empty dimensions are accepted; short slices return DimensionMismatch.
